$comment: Wilsonart (laminate and surfacing) runs Magento 2 on wilsonart.com with a custom wilsonArt_pdp template; design pages are /<design-slug>-<code> (for example /beigewood-7850; from the sitemap). Prices are US dollars and shown only as a $0.00 placeholder (samples and quotes), so price is not configured and the price is null with state unknown and a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. Title is the design name h1, description is the qkView_description paragraph. The gallery image is a JavaScript placeholder in the server HTML (no product image in markup), so image is not configured. The design repeat and finish are written as text inside list items ('Design Repeat (Width X Length): 18" X 51.417"', 'Finish: 60 Matte'), which the specs reader cannot pair, so fetch.engine is default (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance): the LLM returns those two specs at 1,600+1,032 tokens, each checked against the page. The selectors are the http fallback and the saved fixture. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title and description (no image, specs or price); browser: the same, slower; duckduckgo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; mojeek, yandex and yahoo blocked or failed; brave: not tried, no key; ai-crawler-avalai: the same fields plus the repeat and finish specs. ai-crawler-avalai is selected because it returns the repeat and finish. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against the saved (curl) Beigewood 7850 laminate page on 2026-11-19.
